Beside them, a part-time pre-completion job over the hours loses its confirmed day (finding 1).

findings.title: _answers_only reads a rule check as a clash, so a part-time job over the hours loses its confirmed day
findings.input: p1 in progress, a2 opt_pre_completion part_time approved 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31, w1 under a2 from 2026-06-01, 25 hours, confirmed_on 2026-10-01; today 2026-10-02
findings.what_happens: opt_pre.part_time_hours fails and is a _clash on w1; the checkins row shows confirmed_on, due and due_days_away null with nothing naming why. With 20 hours, or with the branch off, it reads 2026-10-01, due 2026-10-31. Exclude nodes with rule in _answers_only.

findings.title: No test sees the count read from a confirmed day that conflicts
findings.input: mutant N5 (the clashed branch of _confirmed off); on_opt(job(confirmed_on=2026-06-10)), start 2026-07-01
findings.what_happens: Under N5 the count shows 10 as of 2026-06-10 with no waits_on while w1.confirmed_on is asked as a conflict; every engine and holdout test passes.

findings.title: The address conflicts reach the screen as a bare do-not-fit line, or as a question about dates
findings.input: A9 and A10 records; questionTitle and conflictQuestionCopy for address.one_first_in_us.ad2 with reason conflict:address.one_first_in_us.ad2
findings.what_happens: Home: 'Address in the US 2: Some facts entered do not fit together.' Result.tsx: 'Are these the dates on your documents?'; a yes un-withholds the A10 report window (2026-10-05). The pack's plain words are YAML comments only.

findings.title: A withheld watch row has no waits_on
findings.what_happens: watch.vi1.expires_on has date null and no waits_on, which point 33 reads as does not apply; the link exists only in span_order.vi1.withholds. Needs a contract change.

findings.title: A not_sure return gives the absence window null dates
findings.input: p1 in progress, home, t1 left 2026-09-20, returned_on not_sure
findings.what_happens: Window dates null, nothing in upcoming, waits on t1.returned_on, from point 32a. Unchanged by fix 4.

findings.title: A no to a check-in is stored and not read
findings.what_happens: The engine reads nothing from it and the same question comes back; the edit screen is W2-P7's.
